description: Play an addictive brain challenge in Match Tile Royal Family. This is not just another match puzzle game. It’s a thrilling mix of logic, strategy, and quick thinking. Your goal is simple yet exciting: match tiles of the same design to clear the board. Unlock levels and rescue the royal family from tricky traps. Eliminate blocks, balls, and other objects in a limited number of moves. You can also use power-ups to quickly clear blocks or temporarily freeze obstacles.

title: CarJamcolor
description:
There was a long queue of passengers at the public station platform with a "car jam" in the parking lot! what to do?

Now it's time for the cars to transport passengers, you need to move them...but wait! You need to do it in the right order. Because other cars in the parking lot that become an obstacle! Can you solve this tricky parking puzzle and get all the cars on the road?
what are you waiting for? Challenge your brain with this tricky game now!

title: Football Heads 2025
description: Unlock your potential and prove your skills. Outplay your opponents using powerful kicks and unique power-ups. Finally let them know who is the boss with the emotes system - become a football legend today!

title: Basketball Stars 2026
description: Basketball Stars is a cool 2 player basketball game by MadPuffers. Prepared for the 2025 basketball season. Choose your team and enter a challenging tournament. Control your player to perform awesome dunks and 3-pointers to win the game. Feel free to block and slap your opponent to knock him out and get the ball, and pay attention to the supershot bar on the top of the screen. Once fully loaded, you can use the hot special dunk from wherever you stand; it never fails. Be the best player!

title: Food Jam
description: Food Jam is a fun and satisfying puzzle game where you sort fruits, veggies, and drinks into the right takeout carts. With over 500 juicy levels, unlock delicious new themes like desserts and juices! Use unique power-ups to clear tricky jams and keep your customers happy.

title: Over the Rainbow
description: Help Alex the Elf return the colors to the rainbow by jumping. Avoid enemies and find power ups to aid you in your quest.

title: Call of the Jungle! Animal Evolution
description:
Feel like the king of the jungle in this casual 3D runner about wild animals. Feed your hungry pet only the right food so that it develops. Collect crystals, level up your character and become the king of beasts in this free online game!

Dive into the exciting world of animals, where your pet will become a real king of beasts. In this exciting casual online game, you have to feed your animal so that it can grow and evolve. Go through exciting races and challenges in the wild jungle.

title: Gun Clone
description:
A free browser game Gun Clone in the arcade and runner genre about cloning guns. Upgrade your weapons, collect cards. The game for girls and boys. The game is endless and pay attention, the levels are simple, but there are also very difficult ones! 
Take weapons and destroy everything in your path! By collecting various bonuses, more and more destructive weapons appear in your hands.

title: Animal Swipe
description: Animal Swipe is a fun and addictive puzzle game where players match adorable animal pairs on a colorful board. With easy-to-learn controls and exciting power-ups, the game offers a challenge for both casual and strategic players. Use your wits and boosts to clear levels and achieve your objectives!

title: Antistress - Simulator Of Sequins DIY
description: ASMR sequin simulator game offers a realistic stress relief experience. Immerse yourself in the world of sequins, where every touch feels real and sensory. The antistress simulator will allow you to relax while enjoying the visual and tactile effects.

title: Fall Bean 2
description: Fall Bean 2 invites you to a colorful, fun-filled world of races! In this chaotic platform game, your goal is to be the last one standing by outmaneuvering other players. Jump, roll, and leave your opponents behind on challenging courses. Overcome new obstacles in each round to reach the final and claim victory! Compete with friends or players from around the world in non-stop action. Join Fall Bean 2 now and enjoy the excitement!

title: Paws & Pals Diner
description:
Welcome to Paws & Pals Diner!

Step into the paws of a diner manager and embark on a delightful 2D adventure where every customer and staff member is an adorable animal! In this charming and whimsical world, you'll manage a bustling diner filled with furry friends, unlock delicious foods, and attract a variety of cute customers.

Are you ready to create the diner of your dreams and make every animal's visit a memorable one?

Join Paws & Pals Diner today!

title: Word search
description:
A beautiful word puzzle game with challenging yet addictive features for hunting down the words you love! Train your brain in a fun and relaxing way and take your critical thinking skills and IQ to the next level.
Find all the words on a given topic. Words are arranged horizontally, vertically, diagonally, and may overlap.

title: Roblox Christmas Dressup
description: Roblox Christmas Dressup is a delightful dress-up game where players embrace the festive spirit by customizing their avatars with Christmas-themed outfits and accessories. The game offers a wide variety of styles to explore, from cozy winter wear to glamorous holiday ensembles. Perfect for fashion enthusiasts and Roblox fans alike, Roblox Christmas Dressup brings creativity and joy to the holiday season.

title: OhPeach-It
description:
OhPeach-It is a game about dash&merge fruits that provides
you fun and engaging gameplay.

Game becomes more engaging when you use the idle mechanism and use power-ups.

So keep the fruits dash and merge !

title: Color Conquest: Territory War
description:
Command one of 4 unique factions in this intense RTS war! Capture territories to expand your army and destroy enemy bases.

Factions:

Grey: High HP (Tank), slow production.

Green: Fast spawn (Swarm), low HP.

Blue & Yellow: Balanced fighters.

Capture neutral zones to increase your unit capacity. Can you dominate the map?

title: Royal Rebellion Punk Magic
description: Two brave girls defy boring traditions and create their own style inspired by punk-rock! Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of anarchy and freedom, where medieval epics are intertwined with daring punk rock. Dress up the girls in leather dresses decorated with spikes and rivets. Create hairstyles that will amaze. Don't forget about makeup: bright lips, bold shadows and provocative piercings. Unleash your imagination by creating images full of energy and rebellion!

title: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner
description:
Become a legendary kunai master in this thrilling combination of dynamic gameplay and classic ninja action. Play offline and enjoy the freedom to dive into the adventure whenever you want. Slice through foes, overcome obstacles, and set out on an epic ninja quest without boundaries.

Will you seize the blade and claim your place as the ultimate ninja warrior?

title: Squishy: Taba Paw ASMR
description: A cute collection of relaxing taba paws and other squishes on your smartphone! Relax by sipping squishes in different directions and enjoy sound of squishing!

title: Halloween Challenge
description: Get ready for a spooky adventure in Halloween Challenge! Bats are flying through the night, carrying candy that you must protect. Your mission? Tap the bats before they escape with the sweet treats. But beware, if even one bat escapes, the game is over! With simple controls and addictive gameplay, Halloween Challenge offers a fun and fast-paced experience for players. Test your reflexes, compete for high scores, and enjoy the eerie Halloween atmosphere. How long can you defend the candy?

title: Merge Hotel Empire
description: You can generate and collect different new items by synthesizing the same items, and then use them to create and decorate a new mansion for the hotel empire of the story.

title: Reversi
description: Challenge your strategic mind against the computer in difficulty levels from absolute novice to expert in this classic game of flipping disks.

title: Sort Game Toy Sort
description: Enjoy some adorable sorting fun in Sort Game: Toy Sort. This delightful match 3 puzzle and casual sort game challenges you to organize colorful dolls and toys. Match and eliminate all dolls within the limited time. When you encounter difficulties, use items to help you quickly clear the level. Such as Convert, Eliminate, Refresh or Break.

title: Your dream room
description:
Do you dream of creating the perfect room? 
In this game you will become a real interior designer! 
Have fun, experiment and turn an empty space into a cozy dream corner.
Choose wallpaper, flooring and furniture in different styles. Decorate the room with stylish accessories, add coziness!
Choose the color scheme and arrange items as you like.
Experiment with design, create unique interiors and enjoy the process!
Start creating your dream room now!

title: Max Crusher: Crazy Destruction and Car Crashes
description:
Max Crusher: Crazy Destruction and Car Crashes is an exciting game in which the player has to become a real wrecking racer.

There are many unique cars available in the game, each of which has its own characteristics and capabilities. From classic sports cars to massive monster trucks, you will have complete freedom to choose the vehicle for your crazy adventures.

title: Office Pyramid Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Pyramid Solitaire is to clear the card pyramid. On hard difficulty you must also clear the draw deck.

title: Zombie Rush
description:
Zombies Rush is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter that pits a lone survivor against an endless, evolving horde. Built for fluid action, this 2D arcade shooter, turns every escape into a high-stakes dance with death.
Tilt and weave through trees to outmaneuver the rush.
Each wave brings faster, smarter, and deadlier undead threats.
Experience a modern take on the classic zombie survival genre with clean, stylized graphics and kinetic combat.

title: Monster School 2
description: Monsters from minecraft are trained at the monster school by Herobrin's teacher. Take the tests, find out who is a Noob and who is a real pro in Bottle Flip challenge, parkour and roller coaster!

title: Horror Minecraft Partytime
description: Horror Minecraft Partytime is a spooky and interesting horror survival game. This time you will enter a familiar world of blocks. In this hide-and-seek mode, you will be the pursuer, looking for every corner. Find the weirdo in disguise and catch him.

title: 3D Kid Sliding Puzzle
description: We've taken the classic sliding puzzle into a whole new 3D world. Kids will need to slide the scrambled blocks to rearrange them and complete adorable cartoon pictures, such as little animals, vehicles, and fairy-tale characters. The game features vibrant colors and lively 3D models that will immediately capture a child's attention. Not only does it provide hours of fun, but it also helps develop a child's logical thinking, spatial awareness, and problem-solving skills.

title: Money Factory - Earn a Billion
description: Prepare for a thrilling journey into the world of finance! As the owner of a money factory, you'll build and link mechanisms to boost your earnings with every step. Overcome exciting challenges where strategy is crucial to your success. Collect powerful boosters, create combos, and unlock new levels to discover even more ways to grow your fortune. Upgrade your factory to fast-track your rise to riches and become a financial powerhouse!

title: Shadowman Runner
description:
Shadowman Runner is a dark, atmospheric endless runner inspired by the minimalist silhouette style of Limbo and the fast-paced arcade spirit of games like Soul Knight and Alto’s Adventure. Set in a mysterious black-and-shadow world, the game challenges your reflexes, timing, and focus.
You play as a lone runner sprinting through a dangerous jungle landscape. Your goal is simple yet addictive: run as far as you can, collect potions to score points, and survive.

title: Italian Brainrot Find the Stars
description: Play Italian Brainrot Find the Stars game online and for free. Find out the hidden stars in the specified images. Each level has 12 hidden stars. There are 12 levels in total. The time is limited so be fast and find all hidden objects before time runs out. Clicking in the wrong place several times reduces the time by an additional 5 seconds. So, if you are ready, start the game and have fun!

title: Math Runner
description: Challenge your mind and reflexes in this fast-paced arithmetic adventure! Solve math problems on the run, dodge obstacles, and race against time to achieve the highest score. Perfect for players of all ages looking to sharpen their math skills while enjoying thrilling gameplay.

title: Snow Race 3d Fun Racing
description: Snow Race 3D: Fun Racing is an addictive arcade game. Do you want to participate in a snow race? This is probably the most fascinating and addictive game you have ever played! Collect the snow around you to make huge snowballs, then let them build ladders and climb to higher levels. Your opponents will have the same talent and you will have to race against time to race against them! Be the first to reach the finish line to win! Come join us and become a snowball master!

title: Pixel Journey
description: The “Pixel Journey” will appeal to all fans of exploration, collecting resources in a cozy pixel world. It combines a cozy atmosphere and addictive gameplay. Reach the end and find out all the secrets! Support us by leaving a review and comment! If you have any comments or suggestions, please describe them and we will try to make improvements quickly!

title: Wild Tanks
description:
Wild Tanks includes two game modes.
This is a survival race and tough tank battles.

Compete in tank races with shooting, earn stars, level up the tanker, upgrade your tank.
Take part in epic tank battles and destroy the enemy.

Break, destroy, destroy everything. Drive through the mountains, crush soldiers, blow up the enemy, have fun to the fullest!

title: Find It - Find The Differences
description: Find It is an engaging puzzle game that tests your observation skills as you search for subtle differences between two nearly identical images. With colorful visuals and beautifully designed scenes, each level presents a fresh challenge. Whether you're spotting tiny details or uncovering hidden objects, Find It will keep you entertained and focused. Hone your attention to detail, enjoy the excitement of finding every difference, and experience hours of fun suitable for all ages!

title: 2048 Match Balls
description: With super simple rules and addictive gameplay, this logic game offers endless fun while challenging your brain. Merge balls and level up. Each merge increases the value of the balls while also changing their color and size. Be smart and dive into a vibrant world of numbers!

title: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D
description: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D is an exciting and simple scooter game where you ride through challenging tracks filled with obstacles. Your main goal is to reach the finish line without crashing. As you play, you’ll need to dodge barriers, keep your balance, and react fast. You can collect coins along the way to unlock new scooters with cool designs. With smooth controls and many levels to explore, the game offers fun, speed, and tricks for anyone who loves action on two wheels.

title: That's my seat!
description: That's My Seat! is a fun and engaging logic puzzle game where you must place characters in the correct seats by analyzing clues. Each level presents a new seating challenge with unique rules and relationships between the characters. Study the hints, think carefully, and figure out where everyone belongs. Perfect for fans of logic puzzles, brain games, deduction games, and casual puzzle games that test your thinking skills.

title: Pretty Sheep Run
description: Play a fun arcade game in Pretty Sheep Run. You guide an adorable little sheep dashing across endless platforms. Keep your sheep running while cleverly avoiding dangerous traps. Control your sheep running to shoot different numbered doors. Change the numbers into positive numbers. Thus increasing the gun's DMG, ATK SPD, etc. Reach the finish line and shoot farther to get rewards. Keep buying guns and merging the same two guns to get upgrades.

title: People Playground: Ragdoll Battle
description:
Welcome to People Playground: Ragdoll Battle!
Carefully control your character to strike the right spots on your opponent’s body. Attack strategically to destroy and crush your enemies. Earn gold coins to unlock new characters and upgrade your skills.
Have fun and dominate the arena!

title: Spooky Link
description: Spooky Link is a relaxing Halloween-themed game where you connect matching spooky tiles. Tap a tile, then tap its match. If the path between them has two or fewer turns, the tiles are cleared. Each cleared tile creates more space to connect others. Enjoy many levels of fun with Halloween surprises!

title: Brainrot Cleaning
description: Welcome to Brainrot Cleaning, the weirdly satisfying cleaning simulation that turns chaos into calm. In this fun and quirky casual game, your job is to scrub away the mess caused by the wild world of brainrot characters and their hilarious antics! In the Cleaning Italian Brainrot or the Underwater mode, you will finish various cleaning tasks.

title: Pet Connect Match
description: Pet Connect Match is an interesting matching game, in this game, you need to connect the same pets to eliminate all of them.  There are many different modes you can choose, you can pass levels, challenge time mode or just play without any limit. Have a good time!

title: Limited Kaboom
description:
Use your buddies to take down the enemy structures and the enemies along with them! 
Can you make survive the hero? 
Use the physics of the world to skillfully take down Sam's enemies!

title: Formula Racing Games Car Game
description: Let's Play and Enjoy car driving in all the Formula Race master 3D tracks of the world and become a champion on all the tracks of the world in the Formula Car Racing Game. Formula Car Stunts Games 3D introduces a new offline car racing game for the fans of the Formula Car simulator.

title: Grass Land
description: Grass Land is a vibrant exploration game that drops you into a sprawling world of thick greenery and hidden surprises. Take control of your grass cutter, uncover valuable resources beneath the overgrowth, and build up your base as you roam the fields. Stay sharp, move fast, and make the most of every patch of grass you find.

title: Dino Hide N Shoot
description: Do you want to begin a fun dinosaur-themed shooting game in Dino Hide N Shoot? Play a brave gunman on an exciting adventure! In this game, you will constantly run to avoid the attack of dinosaurs.And pick up the bullets, accumulate enough firepower. Pay attention to using the box as cover,seize the moment to shoot at the dinosaur! The gameplay is simple yet challenging.

title: Stack n Sort
description:
Welcome to Stack n Sort, the ultimate color stack game that combines precision, hoop sort strategy, and excitement in one addictive experience.

Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant stack color and dynamic hoop sort challenges as you test your skills and aim for high scores. Whether you’re a casual gamer or a competitive enthusiast, hoop stack offers endless fun and engagement.

title: The Lost City - Match 3
description:
Hit three in a row and get a crazy field explosion!
Use colorful booster effects that will make the game even more fun and colorful!
No stressful time restrictions! Enjoy the adventure freely!
Go through a wide selection of mysterious and mystical stages.
Complete various levels and get happiness from breaking gems!

title: Mona Lisa Fashion Experiments
description: Welcome to a small humorous adventure in which you will try on the role of a stylist for the most mysterious lady of all time - Mona Lisa Gioconda. Connect the past and the present by mocking trends and memes. Each of your changes is a small work of art, and each outfit immediately causes fireworks of pleasant emotions. There is no framework here - only freedom of expression. And the variety of images is guaranteed to make your time in the game unforgettable!

title: Farm Block
description: Farm Block is an engaging farm-themed puzzle game where players slide adorable animal blocks to free them from the farm. Test your strategic thinking and enjoy the charming countryside setting! With its mix of puzzle-solving and elimination mechanics, Farm Block offers a fun and rewarding challenge for all ages.

title: Monster Truck Crush
description: Monster Truck Crush is a skillful balanced monster truck racing arcade game. With 3D monster trucks, you need to defeat the AI opponent by arriving at the finish line in the first place. You can speed up immediately when your vehicle is balanced on the next platform. Or else, you will lose some speed or roll the truck. The AI opponent is good at controlling the speed. But you can control the body angle of the car to keep speeding up. Good luck!

title: Eco Block Puzzle
description: Unleash your creativity in a classic block puzzle game, then collect pets like in farming games! You are commanding the team of ecologists who are restoring the valley after an environmental catastrophe.

title: Stack Blocks Connect Wooden Blocks!
description: ● This is a game in which you have to connect wooden blocks?! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a playing area? where you must connect blocks to fill the line! Once the line is full, the blocks will disappear and give you the most points?! Compete with friends or colleagues on the leaderboard?! Enjoy your game?!

title: Construction Set - 3D Builder
description:
Dive into the fascinating world of 3D constructors and puzzles, where each block is a new step towards creativity and development.
This game invites players to assemble amazing buildings, monuments and characters using more than 200 different bricks.
From simple sets to complex models, each level presents a new challenge and develops attention, logic and spatial thinking.

title: Puzzle - LINES AND KNOTS 1
description:
Easy to understand mechanics, swap hexagons with lines.
The goal of the player is to assemble a puzzle consisting of nodes.
▪ 150 Levels
▪ Achievements

title: Blocksss
description:
Blocksss is challenging, exciting and sometimes infuriating minimalist puzzle game. Enjoy the world's most beloved puzzle game for FREE!
Easy to play, and pleasurable game for all ages.

title: Boost Your Brain!
description: "Boost Your Brain!" is an exciting incremental game where you develop your mind by collecting Aiku! Click the magic book, upgrade skills, collect pets with bonuses, and customize with skins. Enjoy deep progression, endless leveling, and cute companions. Reach new heights and become a genius!

title: Find & Restore: Hidden Puzzle
description:
Find & Restore: Hidden Puzzle! is a relaxing and brain-teasing puzzle game where you must spot, drag, and fix the misplaced parts of beautiful images.
Each level challenges you to find hidden pieces, pull them out, and place them exactly where they belong.
With handcrafted levels, soothing music, and satisfying visuals, it's the perfect game to relax and train your observation skills.
Can you restore every picture to perfection?

title: The Superhero League
description: Want to join the Superhero League and unlock endless puzzle fun? In The Superhero League, you’ll become a superhero and begin an exciting puzzle adventure. Take on various killing missions, solve puzzles, and save the world. Control your hero through challenging levels and become the strongest hero of all! This creative puzzle game combines superhero elements with rich strategy gameplay.

title: Last Standing
description: Players are dropped onto a map and start without weapons. The map is scattered with a wealth of weapons and equipment. Players need to constantly explore and collect these resources to enhance their survival ability and combat power. The core goal of the game is to be the last survivor. Usually, there are multiple players in each game, and they are randomly distributed on the map.

title: Crazy Bus Station
description: Embark on a thrilling puzzle adventure! Maneuver buses through challenging parking lots, match cars with their passengers, and clear the path. Unlock unique vehicles, tackle puzzles of all difficulty levels, and use boosters to sort or shuffle when needed. With vibrant graphics and creative gameplay, this game offers fun for players of all ages!

title: Fish Story 4
description: Fish Story 4 returns with its biggest underwater Match-3 adventure yet! Dive into over 4,500+ colorful levels packed with fun challenges, clever puzzles, and sparkling ocean treasures. Join your friend Mermaid on Daily Missions to earn coins, boosters, and special rewards every time you play. Take part in exciting Treasure Hunt events and uncover hidden pirate loot beneath the waves. Relax, match, and explore the deep blue sea!

title: Tony Archer
description:
Evil hooligans have caught your friends, free them quickly and punish the villains!
You are the great Tony Archer, a dude who masterfully handles all types of weapons, can run fast and is a former military man! In his hands, even a stick becomes a deadly weapon! And Tony Archer knows how to stealthily eliminate enemies. Every villain in this city will be punished and all the main character's friends will be saved! Fight on city rooftops, secret laboratories and enemy military complexes.

title: Stick Boy: Bazooka Ragdoll
description: Unleash chaos in Stick Boy: Bazooka War! Blast through levels with a variety of powerful bazookas, each with unique abilities. Obliterate enemies, destroy bases, and demolish everything in your path. Choose the perfect ammo to send ragdoll foes flying and experience thrilling destruction as you crush their strongholds. Help Stick Boy annihilate all adversaries and conquer every level in this explosive adventure!

title: Noob Legends Dungeon Adventures
description: Dive into a thrilling 2D action-platformer! Battle zombies, drones, upgrade weapons, rescue friends, & uncover hidden secrets!

title: Ninja Crossword Challenge
description: It's time to test your vocabulary with Ninja Crossword Challenge, an educational puzzle online game for everyone, and a free game for kids to improve their vocabulary. All you have to do is fill in the words in the grid, the game has more vocabulary than you can imagine, ready to take on my challenge?

title: Suika Kawaii Cat Merge game
description: The game is a fun, puzzle-based merging game where players control a dropper that releases animals onto the field. Players must carefully move the dropper to align and drop matching animals. When two of the same type collide, they merge into a higher-level animal. The goal is to keep merging and progressing to create new animals. Special buttons offer abilities like shaking the container or merging random animals, adding strategy and excitement to the gameplay.

title: Super Pop Blast
description: Get ready for a new kind of brick shooter, with unique mechanics, rewarding challenges, and colorful levels. The object: Clear all the blocks using a limited number of balls. Plan your moves, use the score combo system, and try to get 3 stars!

title: Red Light Green Light
description: Step into the thrilling world of Red Light Green Light, a fast-paced and addictive game inspired by the classic playground challenge! Test your reflexes, strategy, and timing as you race against others to reach the finish line without getting caught.

title: Purrfect Bakery
description: Purrfect Bakery is a cozy and heartwarming game where a sweet cat runs a bakery for cute animal customers. Serve yummy treats, unlock new adorable visitors, and enjoy the simple joy of baking and friendship!

title: Slope Spooky
description: Slope Spooky is a Halloween-themed! A ball rolling down difficult and eerie slopes is controlled by the players. It's almost Halloween, which means Slope needs some scary stuff!

title: Hidden Kitty
description:
Hidden Kitty is an engaging and delightful hidden object game for kids, available for free! Step into a world of adventure as you help an old lady reunite with her beloved kitties, who are playfully hiding throughout the building.
Embark on a Kitty-Finding Adventure

title: Wave Road 3D
description: Wave Road 3D is a fast-paced reflex game that challenges your focus, timing, and precision. You control a sleek arrow gliding through a floating road filled with gears, traps, and collectible gems. Whether you’re chasing high scores in endless mode, conquering 20 handcrafted levels in classic mode, or racing head-to-head with a friend in 2 player mode, Wave Road 3D offers a refreshing and dynamic experience.

title: Giant Wanted Monster
description: The city is being occupied by giant monsters. You, as an elite sniper, pick up your sniper gun. Defeat these crazy monsters and protect the survival of humanity. In Giant Wanted Monster, the fate of the city is at stake with every bullet. You need to use the powerful sniper weapon to shoot accurately from a distance and hit the monster's Achilles heel.

title: Mineblock Obby
description: Minecraft Obby is an amazing parkour game that you can play totally free! Do your best as you navigate through challenging obstacle courses, avoiding pitfalls and traps along the way. Collect coins scattered throughout each level to buy yourself a new sword and enhance your gameplay experience. With each jump and sprint, you'll improve your skills and push your limits. Dive into the blocky world of Minecraft Obby, avoid obstacles, collect those coins, and most importantly—have fun!

title: TOP HOG
description: Welcome to the forest adventure! A drowsy bear just wants to rest, but a playful group of hedgehogs  has decided to throw a party close by. Your task? Grab a hockey stick and send those troublemakers soaring through the air! Build your strength, collect bonuses to enhance your skills, and face the exciting challenges in each level. Who will rise as the winter forest champion? Become a true bear hockey expert! Simple to play, fun, and packed with thrilling airborne action! Give it a try now!

title: Magic Finger
description: Magic Finger 3D is a casual physics game where you use your magical powers to defeat alien foes creatively. Use your magic touch to throw enemies at each other, utilize explosive barrels for big impacts, and send adversaries off platforms. Control your surroundings by picking up and manipulating objects, becoming the ultimate magic user.

title: Lambo Traffic Racer
description: Lambo Traffic Racing, you will be playing lambo cars through endless highway. It is a great game for kids and adults. Great fun, great graphics and great lambos to drive .

title: Motorcycle simulator offline
description: Get ready for an exotic stunt master & adventurous high ground city jumper sports bike simulator game.For bike racing fans and motor bike riders this exotic sports bike simulator is a real fun game. Just start your engine and hit the gas of an extreme bike to experience the stunt master thrill of high ground city jumper motorbike racing & enjoy sports bike sound.

title: Pumpkin Catcher
description:
Fly on a jetpack between walls and avoid rotating traps. Catch pumpkins using your favorite monster: zombie, vampire, devil or even a cat!

Try this challenging Halloween game and set a new world record in catching pumpkins. Compete with your friends on the online leaderboard! Collect them all!

title: Twisted Rope
description: Get ready for a mind-bending challenge! ? Twisted Rope Puzzle 3D is a captivating game that will put your problem-solving skills to the test. Dive into a colorful world of tangled ropes and work your way through increasingly complex puzzles.

title: Zombie Horde: Build & Survive
description: Step into the chaos of Zombie Horde: Build & Survive, a free online game where your survival depends on smart defenses and sharp shooting. Play on your phone or computer as you fight off endless waves of the undead. Set up turrets, lay traps, and build barricades to hold the line while unleashing powerful weapons. In this post-apocalyptic world, every second counts—can you keep the horde at bay?

title: Greek Tower Stacker
description:
Build the tallest structure by stacking beautiful new floors. Each floor contains intricate pillars and arches reminiscent of the mighty Greek civilization.

Challenge yourself to create the most majestic tower in ancient history.

title: Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire
description:
Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.
Be the hero the world needs!
Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.

title: ASMR Makeover & Makeup Studio
description: Get ready to dive into the world of beauty and creativity! ASMR Makeup & Makeover Studio offers an incredible opportunity to give your virtual model a stunning makeover. This isn't just any makeover game — it's an immersive experience that combines relaxation and excitement through the power of ASMR!

title: Real Racing 3D
description: Immerse yourself in exciting racing! Play classic cars - step on the gas and win! Win championships and unlock new cars!

title: Idle Supermarket Tycoon
description: Build and manage your dream shopping mall! Expand by adding new shops, upgrade interiors, serve customers, and boost your reputation. Invest wisely, assign priority shoppers, and earn extra income with delivery vehicles. Complete missions to unlock rewards!

title: Zombie Terminator
description: Zombie Terminator is an exciting first-person shooter game where players take on the role of a survivor in a world overrun by a zombie outbreak. Players must survive and hunt zombies in this post-apocalyptic setting. The game attracts numerous players with its intense combat experience and rich weapon system.

title: Stickman Rogue Online
description: Get ready for an exciting stickman adventure! You will enter an exciting survival battlefield.Fight nervous battles against increasing enemies constantly. Collect experience points and progress through endless waves of enemies. Each wave of enemies is more challenging, so be careful to upgrade your skills to survive! Collect energy boosters in battle to upgrade your stickman skills. Increase speed, increase attack or increase defense.

title: Collect Em All
description:
Collect Em All! Is a puzzle game where you connect all the adjacent same colored blocks. Make long chains of colors to create beautiful sounds and unlock explosive power-ups!

Connect the dots to crush them. You can make a limited number of moves, and you cannot go back on yourself, so make sure to plan your path. Create the longest chains for the biggest reward!

 Come back every day to unlock new daily bonuses !

title: Jelly Block Puzzle
description: Dive into the fun with our vibrant jelly merging game! Explore a world filled with countless levels, merge jellies, use power-ups, and stay entertained. Challenge your brain and see how far you can go in this delightful, jelly-colored adventure!

title: Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game
description: Dive deep into the vibrant and enthralling world of fruit-matching with our exciting game, Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game! When the same fruits collide, they merge into a larger fruit. Your mission is to smartly pair the same types of fruits to make the biggest possible fruits without letting them overflow from the container. However, as the fruits grow in size, space becomes a premium - managing it effectively is your key challenge. Can you strategize and solve this fruity puzzle?

title: Pin Puzzle Love Story
description: Are you ready to use your logical mind to save love? In Pin Puzzle-Love Story, you face a series of interesting and challenging levels. Pull pins in the right order to solve puzzles and help couples reunite. Each level is a new Logic puzzle that can only be successfully completed by pulling the right latch!

title: Super Cloner 3D
description: In Super Cloner 3D, you are a unique super cloner on a mission to infiltrate dangerous environments. Use your cloning powers to escape traps, kill enemies, and accomplish secret missions.

title: Merge Christmas
description: Merge Christmas is a festive puzzle game where you combine matching snowballs to create new character / bigger snowballs, and unlock a cozy Christmas world. Relax and merge Christmas-themed snowballs in a cheerful winter atmosphere perfect for the holiday season.

title: Extreme Makeover Harley Edition
description: In the Extreme Makeover: Halrely Edition you witness the complete transformation of a famous villain. Are you ready to give it a try? Play it today and give her a full makeover routine, starting with removing the two signature colors in her hair, then dealing with her makeup, manicure, and more. Don't forget to also dress her up in something girly-girl and super-colorful so she can strut her stuff through the streets of Gotham City.

title: Witch & Fairy BFF
description: Two unusual girlfriends - a Fairy and a Witch - study together, although they are so different. Fairy, with her delicate pink outfits and impeccable sense of style, is always ready to offer fashion tips and create vivid images. Her girlfriend-Witch, who prefers a Gothic style, chooses mysterious and gloomy outfits. Players will be able to help both heroines choose outfits for various events. Join magical friends in their exciting fashion adventure where style and magic go hand in hand!

title: Paint Sponges Puzzle
description: Challenge your logic and strategy in this exciting puzzle game! Swipe to move the sponge and color every square in the maze with vibrant colors. It might seem straightforward, but don’t be fooled! Each level brings more complex mazes to test your problem-solving skills. Plan carefully, avoid traps, and complete all levels. Sharpen your mind and enjoy victories in this colorful adventure!

title: Squid Candy Challenge
description: Come and take part in the Squid-Candy-Challenge, a classic candy-cake-picking puzzle game for free. This is a wonderful online game for kids where you just have to cut the candy cake intact in a limited time, being careful not to break it, in order to succeed in the challenge. Can you complete the task?

title: Soo Match: Room Design
description: Soo Match! is a fun and engaging blast game. Players progress by tapping and matching blocks of the same color to complete levels. At the end of each level, tickets can be used to complete rooms and unlock new stages, while in-game coins can be spent to acquire new characters. With its charming graphics and diverse game modes, Soo Match! offers a dynamic and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Crazy Goose Simulator
description: Crazy Goose Simulator is here. Ready to flap your wings, honk loudly, and cause total chaos in this fun goose simulator. It is full of crazy missions, fun adventures, and wild animal antics. You'll play the role of a completely mad goose. And start a series of outrageous and exciting quests in a quiet village.

title: Tricky Arrow
description: Get ready to sharpen your skills in Tricky Arrow! Test your precision and reflexes as you shoot arrows at a spinning circle target. Aim for the bullseye and avoid hitting other arrows. With each twist and spin, the challenge grows, requiring strategy and accuracy. Simple yet addictive gameplay for all ages.

title: Battler
description: Immerse yourself in the world of tactical card battles, where your victory depends on the right choice and combinations of skills! You are fighting against decks of treacherous enemies. Choose one of three unique characters and immerse yourself in exciting battles. Use the character editor to fine-tune your character, adding unique abilities.

title: Real Cars Epic Stunts
description:
Flashy and modified super-sports cars and their drivers are ready for the show in Real Cars Epic Stunts game. Play against time in dozens of different stunt tracks and try to complete the show. Unlock new cars or upgrade your car with the coins and diamonds you collect.

Game Features:

● Realistic car physics and appearance. ( Cars get crushed and smashed )
● Upgradeable cars
● 1 Player and 2 Player modes
● Mega ramps for epic stunts

title: Choco Blocks
description: Enter the delightful world of Choco Blocks, a tantalizing puzzle adventure where strategy meets sweetness! In this engaging game, your task is to pick and drop sets of blocks to complete rows. But there’s a sweet twist: special chocolate blocks are hidden within the rows, waiting to be collected. Your mission is to strategically arrange the blocks and collect all the specific choco blocks from the board before time runs out.

title: Erase the extra element
description: Sharpen your focus and logic in Erase the Extra Element! Erase parts of each scene to reveal clues and solve tricky visual puzzles.

title: Fairy Wingerella
description: Soar through the skies with Fairy Wingerella in this action-packed arcade adventure! Meet Wingerella, a fearless and ambitious fairy striving to become the most powerful of her kind. Embark on her magical journey, navigating enchanting skies and conquering exciting challenges. With captivating visuals and engaging gameplay, this adventure promises endless fun and excitement!

title: Zombies and Guns
description:
Urgently save: the evil spirits are coming!
You are a Fighter, who is attacked by hordes of zombies and all sorts of evil spirits! Don't let them eat you alive!

title: Solitaire Story TriPeaks 5
description: The highly anticipated 5th installation of one of the most popular Solitaire Card Games of all time! Foxy, the game’s cute little character, will take you on a journey to new destinations, visiting distant countries, fantastic landscapes, and famous landmarks.

title: Slicer Duo
description: Slicer Duo is a satisfying ASMR game where precision, timing, and rhythm come together in a sharp slicing adventure. Move through level-based stages, cut through fruits and all kinds of objects, collect points, and try to keep your knife in motion for as long as possible. While the controls are simple, every section demands focus because one bad move can send your knife straight into danger.

title: Match Find 3D
description:
Are you a master player of finding games?Do you enjoy matching puzzle games?Come to challenge this addictive puzzle game - Match Find 3D!
Unique gameplay, a combination of collecting and matching, and well-designed levels that will keep you entertained.

title: Powerful Punch
description: Ready to let off some steam? Powerful Punch is the perfect game to brighten your day and release your frustrations. Rescue the weak, take down villains, and unleash your spooky punch, sprunky punch, or even a spranky punch in levels filled with surprises and hilarity

title: Flower Fairy Adventure Story
description: Welcome to Flower Fairy Adventure Story, a casual puzzle game that you can play for free. Flower Fairy lost her wings! Embark on an adventure where you solve each tiny jigsaw, dress up your girl in pretty clothes, and pave the way for the Flower Fairy. Practice your observation, logical thinking, and hands-on ability while enjoying the relaxing and captivating puzzle game.

title: Pick Brainrot: 3D Battle
description: Choose one of two Brainrots, transform into them, and engage in intense battles with other players. Defeat opponents and unlock new abilities: a Brainrot morph, unique weapons, and powerful abilities. Every battle is a chance to prove yourself! At level 5, you'll unlock a protective shield, and at level 10, you'll unlock slow-motion , which will give you a huge advantage in battle. Earn titles for your victories, from "Noob" to a true "Pro"!

title: Komaru cat
description:
Take care of Komaru the cat! Pet her, feed her, bathe her, and tuck her in for sleep!
Dress her up in stylish looks! Hats, glasses, collars, new fur colors, and more! Experiment and create your own unique cat!
Play the merge mini-game, compete on the leaderboard, and earn coins!
Watch the best video memes with funny moments from her life!
Complete the daily challenges and come back tomorrow, Komaru will miss you!
Try to unlock all achievements! Come and have fun!

title: Bomby
description: Launch into fun with Bomby Birds, a slingshot arcade game inspired by the style of Angry Birds! Pull, aim, and fling your bird through tricky levels filled with blocks and obstacles. Perfect for students searching cool math games, bird games, or quick school break fun. With addictive gameplay, silly physics, and nonstop action, Bomby is the ultimate free kids game for anyone who loves arcade challenges and slingshot adventures!

title: Challenge Your Friends
description: Challenge yourself! With seven different games, you can experience thrilling moments whether you're playing solo or competing against your friends. Drunken Duel, Tug The Table, Stick Duel, Milk The Cow, and many more games are waiting for you! Plus, to make the competition even more fun, you can choose exciting dares to make  the matches unforgettable! For those who prefer solo play, 6 games are ready to keep you entertained! Step into this world of fun and enjoy the thrill of competition!

title: My Fire Station World
description: Have you ever wondered how the firefighter rescues and helps others in emergencies? How do they deal with dangerous fires? This role-play takes you to explore the world of firefighters and learn about their daily work. Our game has 6 scenarios about the life and work of firefighters for you to choose from. You can drag and drop to place the characters as you like, place props, and change the firefighting costumes.

title: Valentine's Day Couple Date
description: Experience the charm of Paris in Valentine's Day Couple Date, an amazing couple dress-up game for girls. Start with a picturesque breakfast and help Ellie glam up. Next, keep their fitness streak alive with a couple's workout as you dress them both in fashionable gym outfits and accessories. Later, style Ellie & Ben for a dreamy rooftop dinner. Choose from trendy clothing, accessories, and chic hairstyles to create the perfect romantic ambiance. Stay tuned for a special surprise from Ben.

title: Solitaire Klondike
description:
Step into the timeless challenge of Solitaire Klondike, an addictive HTML5 card game designed for fans of classic solitaire. Enjoy hours of relaxing gameplay with this popular version of Klondike Solitaire, where players arrange cards in descending order and alternate colors to win. If you need a fresh start, simply shuffle new cards to explore different winning strategies!
Perfect for anyone who loves solitaire,  Solitaire Klondike combines strategy, patience, and quick thinking.

title: Heroic Knight
description: Guide the noble knight through peril and claim the treasure! In this exciting puzzle game, you'll shift barriers to clear a path to victory. Help the knight defeat enemies, avoid traps, and uncover hidden riches. Plan your moves carefully, as one wrong decision could cost you the treasure!

title: Farm Business Saga
description: Create the farm you’ve always wanted in Farm Business Saga! ? Plant crops, care for animals, trade products, and grow your farming empire. With beautiful visuals, endless ways to customize, and engaging simulation gameplay, it’s fun for all ages!

title: Caterfall 2048
description: Caterfall 2048 is a vibrant reimagining of the classic 2048 puzzle set in a cozy feline atmosphere. It combines familiar merging mechanics with a hexagonal grid and fun "jelly" physics. This game is perfect for all puzzle lovers — whether you want to relax or you're a competitive player striving for a new high score.

title: Agent Squad
description:
Looking for an engaging casual shooter that’s easy to get the hang of but offers engrossing action and real tactical challenges? 
Agent Squad is a top-down shooting game with intelligent mechanics, loads of cool upgradable guns, and addictive gameplay

title: Lemonade Tycoon Idle
description: Tap your way from a humble lemonade stand to a global empire! Serve customers, unlock upgrades, hire staff, and expand across the world. With a dynamic day/night cycle and relaxing lo-fi music, this is the ultimate idle lemonade experience.

title: Sweetsu Tile Puzzle
description: Sweet Tile Puzzle is a relaxing yet strategic game. Match 3 identical Japanese-themed tiles by drawing them into a limited stack. Clear the board by collecting all tiles while managing space wisely. With each level, challenges grow as the stack shrinks and more tiles appear. Can you master the art of tile matching?

title: Fish Land Fish World
description: Explore a colorful underwater world full of fishing excitement. In Fish Land - Fish World, you’ll become a fishing expert in this relaxing idle fishing adventure! This game combines simulation and fishing elements. Allow you to fish, expand your pond, and grow your aquatic world.

title: Soccer Euro Cup 2025
description:
Can you hear the deafening cheers of a mighty crowd? Get pumped for the Soccer Euro Cup 2025!

Pick your favorite country to represent and get ready for kickoff. Do your best to kick or headbutt the ball into your opponent's goal!

How many did you manage to score? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Hoop World 3D
description: Hoop World 3D is a flip-and-dunk game that brings basketball to a whole new dimension! Get your timing right or you'll fall short of the net and fall flat on your face.

title: Color Sort Puzzle
description: Spend your time wisely, relaxing and training your mind all at once! Put the water in the most strategic flask and enjoy when everything falls into place.

title: Kitty Squad Winter Dress Up
description: Step into the adorable world of Kitty Squad Winter Dress Up, where you can style your kitty for the winter season! Choose from cozy outfits, cute accessories, and festive winter gear to create the perfect look for your furry friend. With its charming graphics and endless customization options, this game is perfect for fashion lovers and cat enthusiasts alike. Start dressing up your kitty today!

title: Farm of Words
description: Welcome to the unusual farm. Each farm specializes in growing its agricultural products. Someone grows and sells livestock, while others-cereal, cereals or legumes, and others-breed gardens and grow fruits and so on, there can be many directions. Our farm is unusual, because in the square plots of the Earth you will grow words. Connect the letters on the round field below, they will unite into words that will grow after watering on land tiles in Farm of Words.

title: Flower Shop
description: Match 6 of the same flowers to ship them! You can place your flowers in any empty spot on the board. Place a flower next to a tray with the same kind to make them merge. When the right conditions are met, customers will come by to visit! Complete their requests to earn rewards. The game ends when there’s no more space left to place flowers.

title: Pesky Moles
description:
An ordinary farmer lived a quiet life and grew vegetables, but at some point, moles began to attack his garden and eat the entire crop.
After the next harvest, he decides to take everything into his own hands and protect his garden.
In Pesky Moles, you have to protect your garden from moles for a certain amount of time. The more pests you manage to neutralize and the more crops you save, the more coins you get. With the coins you earn, you can buy traps that will help you protect your garden.

title: Conduct This
description: Conduct This is a cartoon-style free puzzle online game played on PuzzleGame for boys. You need to move the obstacles on the track so that the train can pass successfully. Get coins for passing levels and unlock the beautiful skins of the train. Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable. I guess it's easy for you. Are you ready to try it now?

title: Color Sand Puzzle
description: Welcome to Color Sand Puzzle! Relax and unwind with Color Sand Puzzle, a refreshing take on the classic block puzzle game! Your mission is simple yet fun—fill the grid with matching colors of sand to clear and control the lines. As colorful sand blocks fall from the top, you’ll need to strategically arrange them to form complete horizontal rows. When the sand lines up from left to right, they disappear, and you earn points!

title: Merry Christmas Stickman
description: Help Stickman escape from jail just in time for the holidays! This time, he’s on his own, relying solely on a mysterious Christmas package filled with special items. Choose carefully to aid his breakout in this festive, story-driven adventure packed with seasonal surprises—can Stickman make it to freedom before the New Year?

title: Serious Head 2
description:
The adventures of a serious head continue.
Portals open, monsters come out.
Prepare for battle: rebuild your base and upgrade your weapons.
Take your partners to help you and put up a decent resistance!

title: Daily Wordler
description:
Test your vocabulary and puzzle-solving skills with Daily Wordler, the ultimate word-guessing game that challenges your mind every day! With a simple yet addictive gameplay mechanic, Daily Wordler is perfect for fans of word games and brain teasers. 

Your goal is to guess the hidden word by entering valid words and using color-coded feedback to narrow down the solution. Yellow tiles indicate correct letters in the wrong position, while blue tiles signal correct letters in the right spot.

title: Crazy Axe
description:
In Crazy Axe, you take control of a fearless warrior, armed with a powerful axe, to conquer a series of action-packed challenges. Swing your axe with precision, crush obstacles, and defeat waves of enemies. The game tests your reflexes and accuracy as you navigate through dangerous environments, dodging traps and outsmarting your foes. With each level, the difficulty ramps up, demanding quick thinking and faster reactions to survive.
Are you ready to take on the challenge and go axe-crazy?

title: Number Rush
description:
You can absorb smaller or equal numbers while avoiding obstacles.
If you collide with a number bigger than you, it's game over.
Make the largest number possible to break through the wall and get the treasure chest~!

title: Tank Sniper 3D
description:
Tank Sniper 3D: The Ultimate Shooting Game
Are you a fan of shooting games? Do you have what it takes to be a sniper tank driver? Then youll love Tank Sniper 3D - the action game that puts your skills to the test. Shoot your enemies with one shot from behind cover. Stay hidden until you strike with a surprise shot. Then, dodge their fire and hit as many targets as you can. How long can you survive? Find out now and play Tank Sniper 3D!

title: Stickman Halloween Survive
description:
Now that Halloween is here, the gloomiest day of the year, it's time to bring back the courageous white stickman who is an expert at vanquishing monsters. Stop procrastinating and start enjoying Stickman Halloween Survive right now on your preferred mobile device. It's a fun and free online game. 
Every living thing on Earth is frightened to death when monsters emerge from their underground lairs on Halloween night.

title: Panda Lu Treehouse
description: Hey, animal lovers! Enter the enchanting world of Panda Lu's Tree House, a super fun casual simulator that will warm your heart. In this game, you play as the caretaker of the adorable panda Lu. Your adventure begins by building a magnificent tree house, a cozy and vibrant home for your furry friend.

title: Plants Warfare
description: Plants Warfare is a shooting game where you step into the shoes of the cute plants. Aim your projectiles, and take down the zombies with strategic aiming and precision shots. Use the environment to your advantage—ricochet bullets and eliminate multiple targets with the least shots possible! Collect stars, customize your look, and prove you’re the ultimate plant defense.

title: Satisdom
description: Step into the calm and quirky world of Satisdom — a game where every little task feels oddly satisfying. Whether you're dragging, tapping, sorting or matching, each level is a chance to relax and have fun. Designed to run smoothly on both phones and computers, Satisdom is the perfect escape for anyone who loves simple pleasures and playful puzzles. Slow down, enjoy the details, and let yourself get lost in the fun.

title: Enchanted Mahjong Saga
description: Enchanted Mahjong Saga is a fast-paced twist on the classic tile-matching game, with unlimited levels to challenge your mind. Match tiles, beat the clock, and keep your streak alive as each level gets tougher and more exciting. Feeling stuck? Use helpful hints to get back on track and stay in the game.Whether youre playing for a quick break or settling in for a longer session, theres always a new puzzle waiting.

title: Triangle Way
description: Soar into action with Triangle Way, a thrilling neon-themed arcade adventure where you pilot a small neon plane through a maze of dangers. Guide your plane safely through hazardous territory, avoiding enemies and obstacles at every turn. With fast-paced gameplay and escalating challenges, this game will test your reflexes and quick thinking. Experience vivid neon graphics, smooth controls, and heart-pounding action as you dodge threats and aim for high scores.

title: Mega Prize Scratch
description: Embark on a fun journey and try your luck with scratch cards. The appearance and value of houses, cars, or animals are in your hands. Win big with the scratchers, complete all the missions, and ensure every story has a happy ending.

title: Cross Connect Word
description:
Fun and relaxing crossword puzzle!

Cross Word Connect is a fun but challenging word game.
Enjoy modern word game with the combine of word search and crossword! In this fantastic crossword puzzle, you will improve your vocabulary and spelling skills.

title: Aloha Mahjong
description: Collect all the Hawaiian items in this daily Mahjong at Home game. Try to clear all tiles by pairing the same free Aloha tiles. A tile is free if it is not covered and has at least one free side.

title: Battle Tanks Firestorm
description:
This game has incorporated the best of famous tank games. 
You can choose the tank that you like best, or prefer a more powerful version. Go to the levels and defend your base from the enemy. At your disposal are more than 15 types of tanks with various upgrades: armor, upgrades of the first, second and third levels. These improvements will help you gain an advantage over the enemy tank army.

title: Dynamons Connect
description:
Dive into the exciting world of Dynamons Connect! This fun and engaging game with adorable, colorful characters helps improve focus and visual perception.
Match identical tiles by connecting them with a path that has no more than two turns to clear the board. With endless levels, the challenge never stops!

title: Shoot Run Monster Hunting
description: Welcome to the interesting parkour world of Shoot Run: Monster Hunting! In this challenging game,you will be a brave shooter. Run, collect, fight and shoot all kinds of scary monsters, show your courage and skill! Enjoy running in a variety of scenarios, challenging speed and agility.

title: Geometry Rush
description: Geometry Rush will take you to a world of challenging and treacherous platforming. Are you ready to run through trap-filled passages, jump and dodge death? Learn from your mistakes, perfect your reflexes, master the path without a single slip and advance to the next level.

title: Steal Car Duel
description:
Step into a high-energy world of engines, rivalry, and fast reflexes. Steal Car Duel is a competitive action game that evolves the idea of Steal a Brainrot into a car-based experience filled with duels, rare collectibles, and endless upgrades!

Race, collide, and steal your way to the top. Build your own garage, earn coins and tickets, and outsmart rivals to prove who rules the arena. Each match combines skill, timing, and strategy as you fight for dominance in Solo or 2 Player mode.

title: Sprunki Coloring Book
description:
Dive into a colorful adventure with Sprunki Coloring Book, a delightful game designed for kids and adults alike. Choose from a wide variety of adorable Sprunki characters, captivating landscapes, and fun designs to color your way. Whether you're a budding artist or simply looking to relax, Sprunki Coloring Book offers endless possibilities for self-expression.
Start coloring today and discover the joy of creativity with Sprunki Coloring Book!

title: Roblox Halloween Costume Party
description: Roblox Halloween Costume Party is the ultimate dress-up experience! Create your spookiest, funniest, or most creative Halloween looks using a variety of Roblox-inspired costumes and accessories. Mix and match outfits to stand out at the party, and get into the Halloween spirit by competing in costume contests with friends. Show off your unique style in this festive and fun-filled game!

title: Sniper Freeze
description: Experience thrilling sniper action in Sniper Freeze, a unique online game where you hunt down moving rule-breakers marked in red. Sharp graphics and challenging gameplay await - stay alert and precise!

title: Secrets of Charmland
description:
● Unique gameplay: help Emma treat her friends by swapping and matching delicious sweets!
● Tons of match-3 levels filled with exciting elements, awesome boosters and explosive combinations!
● A world full of Charmland: discover all the magical places it has to offer!
● Fantastic characters: watch Emma making new acquaintances and helping them with their unusual quests.

title: Rent out - Landlord Tycoon
description: In this captivating world of landlord games, you'll start with a modest property portfolio and a dream to become the ultimate real estate and house tycoon. Your goal is to buy, sell, and manage properties to maximize your profits and become a successful business and house tycoon in this rent game. Whether it's residential apartments, commercial complexes, or luxurious villas, it's your chance to be rich in this rent game.

title: Emoji Challenge
description: Emoji Challenge is an engaging skill game. Featuring levels constructed entirely with popular emojis. The game offers six distinct puzzle types: link puzzle, memory puzzle, word quiz, related puzzle, shadow puzzle, and crop puzzle. This game is perfect for players who enjoy brain teasers and want to test their problem-solving skills.

title: Ball Dunk Fall
description: In Ball Dunk Fall, your challenge is to guide a constantly falling ball through hoops of varying difficulties by tapping the screen. Test your precision and reflexes as you navigate through tricky obstacles. With each successful dunk, experience the thrill of victory and aim for high scores!

title: Juicy Match
description: Tired of candies? Dive into Juicy Match and explore a world of natural, fresh, and juicy delights! You run the best Juice Bar in town, where you match a variety of fruits, from tropical to classic, to create the perfect juice blends. Your cheerful friend, Tiki will guide you with tips and tricks. Match three or more identical fruits to juice them and complete levels. Create chain reactions for extra bonuses and points. Enjoy a refreshing, juicy adventure with Juicy Match!

title: Flower Block
description: Dive into our unique COMBO gameplay, where you strategically place blocks to clear rows or columns. Watch as clearing multiple lines triggers exciting animations and earns you bonus points. Challenge your mind and plan your moves wisely to ace Flower Block!

title: Find Goods
description: Find and tap on goods! Clear the stage when you find all the goods. Game over when time runs out. You can scroll and zoom the map. Be careful, as tapping items other than those specified will reduce the time limit.

title: Noob Draw Punch
description:
Play this fascinating game and enjoy yourself. The Imperfect Punch Enjoy yourself as you sketch out the path of your character's punch. Assist the rookie player in surviving the onslaught of monsters (such as huggy, kissy missy, catnap, and more) that they encounter throughout the game.

Luckily, you'll have a strong fist that can track the monsters, so you can assist the young newbie escape alive from this trap. He's afraid when he meets all the creatures in Poppy Playtime.

title: Sword Run 3D
description: Sword Run 3D is an easy to pick up action runner game. Collect sword pieces, cut off the obstacles that block your progress, and finally reach the finish line to win. More cool skins are waiting for you to unlock, what are you waiting for? Don't forget to share it with your friends if it's fun!

title: Build a Go-Kart
description:
Build your karting empire from scratch — from simple straights to complex tracks with boosts and risky turns.

Design unique tracks using modular blocks: combine elements, optimize your route, and find the perfect balance between speed and profit. Every ride earns money — and your track design determines how much you make.

title: Slenderman Back to School
description: On a very mysterious night you wake up and find yourself trapped in your high school, a town in Massachusetts, and you will have to survive until dawn and escape from the urban legend Slenderman. In Slenderman Back to School, a 3D online game, you will be able to feel the adrenaline that a horror game feels like.

title: Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon
description: Welcome to Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon! Do you dream of owning your own movie theater empire? Now's your chance! In this super fun idle simulation management game, you'll start with a small screening room! Build your own cinema empire! As a theater owner, you need to manage every aspect of the theater. Unlock the theater's facilities, ticket booths, movie halls, dining areas, and more. Hiring employees to help you get more bang for your buck.

title: Drunk Man 3D
description: Drunk Man 3D is a challenging and comedic 3D Ragdoll Physics game. In this game, players must navigate a treacherous cityscape while emulating the hindered balance of inebriation. The game features ragdoll physics, where even minor collisions can cause players to lose control and stumble.

title: Letters Match
description: Letters Match combines the best of the games you love. This is a mixture of matching games, word search and clearing the playing field. We took all these ingredients and spiced it up with exciting gameplay. If you like to stretch your brain with puzzles, then Letters Match is what you need!

title: SUV Traffic Racer
description: In SUV Traffic Racer, you will be playing SUVs through stunning endless highways. Skim through the highway traffic and make the highest score by going as far as you can, Unlock more than 6 SUVs to make the ultimate SUV garage. Upgrade your SUV with 4 awesome upgrades and get the most out of those roaring engines. Enjoy the picturesque highways and conquer it with your driving skills. Are you ready to show if you're the finest highway racer out there?

title: Sprunki 3D Shooter
description: Sprunki 3D Shooter delivers nonstop action as you face off against waves of Sprunkies! Your mission is simple: shoot to survive as long as you can. Run out of ammo? Search the battlefield for scattered rounds to keep the fight alive. Gear up and prepare to take on the Sprunkies—can you last the challenge?

title: 3 Tiles
description:
Cutely shaped picture tiles are mixed and stacked. 
Find the tiles in the same picture from the top and group them together. 
Clear the stages by removing tiles from all fields!

title: Click Click Clicker
description: Click Click Clicker is a single-player, idle clicker game where you earn money by clicking the button on the screen. Unlock various buttons, cursor styles, themes, and music.

title: Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem
description:
Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem is an exciting motorcycle racing game. 
In this game you will become a motorcycle racer who travels through city streets and highways, avoiding collisions with other vehicles. You will be able to unlock faster and more powerful motorcycles, each with its own unique handling characteristics, as well as improve the characteristics of your motorcycle. One of the key features of the game is a realistic physics engine that makes the gameplay challenging and exciting.

title: Flick Baseball Super Homerun
description:
Experience various baseball pitches based on the pendulum movement. The ball will fly further if you can hit the ball directly with the quick flick. Experience a “real-life like” batting simulation in this baseball game.
# One Flick Easy Control
You only use flick to control the batting for this game. The more accurate you flick your finger to hit the ball; it is more likely that you will be a home-run hitter.

title: THE SURVEY
description:
After a long work time when you ready to play games in your computer and start a survey  and it's shows you the things that you don't want to watch and know!
- 5-10 min Gameplay
- Atmospheric Enveronment
- Intrective Gameplay

title: Sandbox Island War
description: Get ready for a wonderful pixel battle in Pixel Island War! This strategy game brings you to a wonderful pixel world. Here your task is to conquer islands and expand your empire. Build bases, gather resources and prepare for fierce battles on different islands. For example, choose an island to place humans on. Humans will build towns and multiply. Choose sheep to produce wool and meat.

title: One HERO
description:
One Hero: Dive into the ultimate action-packed shooting game! Play as a lone hero, dodging and shooting your way through waves of enemies. Eliminate all foes to claim victory. Are you ready to be the last one standing?
Dive into a thrilling, action-packed adventure where you’ll face waves of enemies and intense boss battles.
With intuitive controls and accessible gameplay, players of all skill levels can jump in and start unleashing chaos in no time.

title: Merge Hospital
description:
Play as Doctor Player in Merge Hospital and discover the many secrets of your staff members, and what is happening in and around the Hospital. In Merge Hospital by Operate Now you will merge and build, meet and love many skilled surgeons, doctors and other interesting characters. You will learn more about their stories and how they got into the hospital.

As Dr. Player you must:
MERGE medical items, pies and much more!
DISCOVER the story of a medical drama like in your favorite TV shows.

title: Doors Awakening
description: This is a challenging puzzle-solving online game.  This game has wonderful 3D graphics enabling you to explore the handcrafted levels. The fascinating visual effects, realistic atmosphere, and natural camera controls will keep you returning for more. If you'd prefer puzzle games, don't miss this wonderful challenge.

title: Super Dog Hero Dash
description: Super Dog Hero Dash is an interesting 3D running game with endless adventure and fun! You’ll become a brave dog hero running through a colorful city in this cartoonish world. Begin exciting challenges across various platforms!

title: Koko Loco Block Blast
description: Think fast, blast smart — can you beat your best score? Blast blocks, fit shapes, and outsmart the grid in this fast-paced puzzle challenge! Every move counts: clear space, chain combos, and keep the board from filling up. With smooth controls, colorful blocks, and quick rounds, it’s perfect for casual fun or deep strategy. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — how high can you climb the high score ladder?

title: Block Blaster Puzzle
description: Aim for high scores or complete level objectives. Rotate and arrange blocks to clear rows and columns while enjoying stunning visuals. Each perfect move brings satisfaction, challenging you to beat your best and master each puzzle!

title: Grand Mahjong Connect
description:
Grand Mahjong Connect is a relaxing yet challenging triple-match puzzle game with a fresh twist on classic mahjong.

Select tiles from the board and match three identical pieces to clear them.
Plan your moves carefully — space is limited, and every choice matters!

Enjoy beautiful tiles, smooth gameplay, and satisfying match effects as you clear the board and progress through levels.

Can you master the art of triple matching?

title: Metro Escape
description: On Metro escape you must search the room for items that will help you escape. Search for itens in the metro and use them to solve the puzzles. Look carefully at the various patterns around the metro and solve the riddles. Good luck to search for your way to escape!

title: Vex Hyper Dash
description:
Get ready for a fast-paced challenge in this brand-new Vex spin-off: Vex Hyper Dash! Inspired by the legendary Geometry Dash. Your goal is simple: survive as long as possible. Jump from platform to platform, time your moves perfectly, and avoid the countless dangers that stand in your way. One wrong move, one mistimed jump, and it’s game over. 

Vex Hyper Dash puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Can you master the flow and set a new high score?

title: Elevator Fight
description: Make your way to the top floor, one fight at a time. Every level, a new challenger steps in, but only one can ride up! With simple controls and over 130 levels, this game offers quick, close-quarters combat in a cramped elevator. Upgrade your fighter’s speed, power, and defense to keep up with the ever-changing, humorous opponents. What’s waiting at the top?

title: Hidden Object Farm Adventure
description: Play a fun hidden object game with 30 farm levels! each level, find 6 hidden things before time runs out. If you need help, use a hint! It's easy to play and full of colorful farm fun.

title: Parking Master Urban Challenges
description:
A realistic 3D parking simulator where you can hone your driving skills and become a real parking master!
Get behind the wheel of realistic cars of different sizes and maneuver through crowded city streets, parking in the most difficult places.
Pass all the tests, become a parking master and prove that you can do any maneuver!

title: Tanks Merge: Tank War Blitz
description:
Embark on an armored adventure in Tanks Merge: Tanks to Attack on the Blitz! -
a strategy game where steel giants dominate the world.
Immerse yourself in a casual yet addictive tank simulation game
designed for those who love war machines and inventive tactics.
Have a blitz rumble and defeat all the bosses!
Your mission: control a fleet of tanks, each unique in design and
to defeat enemies and all bosses on the battlefield.

title: Supermarket Shopping For Kids
description: Have you ever dreamed of owning your own supermarket? In this casual supermarket simulator game, you can make your dream come true! In our Supermarket Shopping For Kids game, you can not only enjoy shopping but also play as a cashier and check out items! Apart from that, there are also many fun mini-games you can join in the supermarket.

title: Stick - Color War
description:
To defeat enemies you must shoot bullets of the same color as the enemy. 
Every five levels you have to defeat a boss.
Breaking off new weapons.
Will you be able to resist the colored sticks?
Play our shooter without downloads and registration.

title: Labuba Halloween Infestation
description: Monsters are invading Halloween! You must destroy them all — the fate of Halloween is in your hands. The game features three different modes, each with tougher and more powerful monsters.

title: Toy Rumble 3d
description: Begin an explosive toy adventure in Toy Rumble 3D. A 3D running and racing arcade game packed with action, speed, and strategy. Move your tank through chaotic obstacle courses, collect parts, assemble your cannon, and shoot your way to victory.

title: Magic Solitaire
description: Welcome to the amazing magical world of solitaire! Here you can make yourself at home, playing layouts on a tavern table by the fireside, or in the shade of an oak tree by a majestic rushing waterfall. Your fairy helper will guide you through this magical world full of mystery and ancient secrets. Magic World Solitaire is the classic solitaire you love in an exciting new world.

title: Math Block
description: Math Block is a brain-teasing puzzle game where you slide numbered blocks and operators on a grid to form valid math equations. Match the target value using addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to earn stars and progress through 500 challenging levels!

title: Tropical Match 2
description: Tropical Match is back with its highly anticipated second sequel! Join your island friend Coco for a colorful Match 3 adventure in a lush tropical paradise. Match juicy fruits, vibrant flowers, and clear away algae and clouds across 1,250+ exciting levels. Complete Daily Missions and discover tropical treasures along the way! With relaxing island tunes and gorgeous scenery, this is the perfect summer escape. Dive in and start your tropical adventure today!

title: Word Search Universe
description: Word Search Universe is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you search for hidden words in a grid. The game has 20 chapters, and each one comes with easy, medium, and hard levels to match your skill. In every level, you need to find 6 hidden words. If you get stuck, you can use a hint to help you out. It's a great way to have fun, improve your vocabulary, and keep your brain sharp!

title: Candy Cascade
description: Click on groups of two or more candies to destroy them. You need to collect certain amount of different sweets on every level.  Wooden blocks, honey and jam should be cleared from the game field. If there is a key on the game field it should be dropped down. The moves are limited for each level. If you have hard time with a task you can use bonuses that can be received when you collect jam.

title: Crush the Eggs
description: In this game, eggs have appeared that you will have to fight with and break. In front of you on the screen you will see a platform on which the egg will be located. Above it you will see a special field. Using the mouse you can draw any object on it. When you finish your actions, this item will fall directly onto the egg. If your calculations are correct, then you will break it and thus destroy it. After this you will move to the next level of the game.

title: Earthquake io
description: Earthquake io is a realistic 3D physics-based disaster simulator in which you take control of the forces of the Earth to destroy cities, destroy buildings and crush all small objects to compete with other players in a fierce battle.

title: Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2
description: Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2 is a famous snake-hunting game when Sprunki head and Squid head as main avatar character in this game.
